verdict.rationale: Sandbox0 runs agent code in an isolated cloud computer separate from the user's host (docs-1). Its credential features authenticate outbound traffic without placing raw secret material inside the sandbox process (docs-15), and outbound traffic can be restricted with SandboxNetworkPolicy (docs-13). Missing for 10: detail on how credential injection works and what isolation boundary is used, plus independent or hands-on corroboration that secrets stay unreachable.
